notes: 'ish kohen is fused under rule 30 on the model of 'ishshah zonah, the ASV spending one word, priest, on the pair; the competing split would leave 'ish holding of any, which rule 30's example forbids.

The competing split — 'ish taking of any as the nomen rectum under rule 19 and kohen taking priest — is defensible; the fusion was taken because the pair has a single lexical rendering and neither of and any is spent on one morpheme in particular.
The bracketed assimilated article of ba-'esh is unrepresented, the ASV writing with fire without a the (rules 12, 29).
